work_title: Make paired HistoryStorage updates atomic across objectsStore, indexStore, and caches (#1443)
description: Fixed non-atomic paired updates in HistoryStorage across objectsStore, indexStore, and in-memory caches using upfront serialization, in-process rollback on indexStore failure, deferred cache updates, a CRC32-verified disk undo journal (pending-batch.journal) replayed automatically on startup, and reader/writer lock isolation, with regression tests in HistoryStorageSpec (ergoplatform/ergo#1443). Upstream PR: https://github.com/ergoplatform/ergo/pull/2874.
